key_insight: Nahual unifies language and 3D molecular generation in one decoder-only model, combining text-based control with native coordinate generation.
engineering_relevance: A single model could support chemistry workflows spanning molecular conformer search, microsolvation, surface adsorption, and crystal structure prediction.
method: Uses a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion architecture for sequences mixing text and 3D molecules.
Applies next-token diffusion: each token is denoised while attending to preceding clean tokens without increasing context size.
Trains one shared set of weights end to end across twelve 3D chemistry tasks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation across twelve curated tasks with task-specific metrics and baselines, including performance surpassing specialized state-of-the-art models for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify inference cost or generalization beyond the curated tasks, leaving deployment efficiency and out-of-distribution reliability to be assessed.
paper_title: Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
